cores.name: Teklo Core
cores.textbox: **Dash Specialization**{br}This enters the arena with 2 steam counters. When this has none, destroy it.{br}At the beginning of your action phase, remove a steam counter from this and gain {r}{r}.

faces.printed_rules_text:
**Dash Specialization** _(You may only have Teklo Core in your deck if your hero is Dash.)_
Teklo Core enters the arena with 2 steam counters on it. When Teklo Core has no steam counters on it, destroy it.
At the beginning of your action phase, remove a steam counter from Teklo Core and gain {r}{r}.

faces.printed_rules_text: **Especialización de Dash** _(Solo puedes llevar Núcleo de Teklo en el mazo si tu héroe es Dash)._{br}El Núcleo de Teklo entra en la arena con 2 contadores de vapor. Destruye a Núcleo de Teklo cuando ya no tenga contadores de vapor.{br}Al principio de tu fase de acción, quita un contador de vapor del Núcleo de Teklo y gana {r}{r}.
